title: Cap. X Arg. V Minor cont.: Tract. 107 — the Father’s prior giving makes them not of the world Christ does not pray for; election makes faithful, not faith elect
pass_a_gloss: And Tract. 107. By this, that the Father has already given them unto him, it has been brought about that they do not belong to that world for which Christ does not pray. As if he had said, By antecedent election it has been brought about that they should be faithful, not by antecedent faith that they should be elect.
pass_b_english: And Tractate 107: By this—that the Father has already given them to him—it comes about that they do not belong to that world for which Christ does not pray. As if to say: antecedent election made them faithful; antecedent faith did not make them elect.
source_text: Et Tract. 107. Per hoc quod eos illi Pater jam dedit, factum est ut non pertineant ad eum mundum pro quo non rogat Christus. Quasi dixisset, Per antecedaneam electionem factum est ut essent fideles, non per antecedaneam fidem ut essent electi.
notes: Densify De praedestinatione Cap. X Arg. VI+ section 730. Pass A!=B. Packet praedestinatione_cap10_arg6_densify.

lemmas.lemma: Per hoc quod ... Pater jam dedit
lemmas.gloss: prior giving excludes them from unelected world
